title: VPAT evidence pack and keyboard navigation remediation for theme tokens
creator: Marina Ortiz
description: Scope: produce a consolidated VPAT evidence package and implement keyboard navigation / focus semantics fixes tied to dynamic theme tokens across buttons, compact tables, and chart widgets. This ticket covers: 1) audit of CSS token aliases used in theming (color/contrast/focus ring) to identify token collisions and insufficient contrast at small sizes; 2) keyboard focus remediation for virtualized tables and compact row actions (arrow key flow, Escape/Enter behaviors); 3) semantic role and live-region mapping for chart brush/legend interactions; 4) tooling to capture visual diffs and automated axe runs per token variant.
acceptance_criteria: 1) VPAT annex exported (PDF) with per-component evidence entries and test steps. 2) Token delta spreadsheet listing token name, old value, new value, WCAG contrast ratio, and rationale for change. 3) Keyboard traversal tests added to the accessibility harness for table rows, dropdowns, and chart legend items (pass on Chromium + VoiceOver on macOS). 4) Two sign-off artifacts: design review approval (Confluence) and engineering PR(s) merged with release notes. 5) No regressions flagged in the visual-diff run for primary themes (light/dark/high-contrast) except documented exceptions.
notes: Partial decisions and trade-offs: we will prefer token alias deprecation over renaming raw tokens to minimize migration churn for client apps. For chart legends with deeply nested filters, we will keep mouse-first hover behavior but add explicit keyboard traps and 'toggle' semantics so keyboard users can Nav->Enter->Space equivalently. We intentionally postpone reworking virtualized row keyboard virtualization heuristic (ENG backlog) — this ticket applies a containment-focused patch that improves ArrowUp/ArrowDown mapping and documents outstanding edge cases. Automation: use nightly visual diff job (per-theme) and axe ci snapshot. Artifacts: Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/DS/VPAT+Theme+Token+Sweep, token spreadsheet (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ThemeTokensEvidence, design mock PR: https://github.com/redwood/design-systems/pull/742, engineering PR: https://github.com/redwood/frontend/pull/5192, accessibility dashboard: https://pulse.redwood.company/a11y/DS-827463.
